newsitem.title: UK: Gorbachev says Yeltsin should step down.
newsitem.headline: Gorbachev says Yeltsin should step down.

text.p: Former Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev said on Sunday Russian President Boris Yeltsin was too sick for his post and should step down.
"Given his condition, he is not capable," Gorbachev said of Yeltsin who is awaiting major heart surgery.

"Of course I hope he stays alive. But to function properly when you need very dynamic leadership for the country to take it out of the crisis, the country needs another president," he said on BBC television.

"Given my experience working under Brezhnev, Andropov, they were sick people. We couldn't solve major problems. All the problems were piling up. Everything was being delayed." Gorbachev, on a trip to Britain to publicise his autobiography, said Yeltsin should step down voluntarily before a crisis develops.
Asked if he would stand again in another Russian presidential election, Gorbachev said: "I will look into it."
